# Sims Prospects

> UK-based B2B lead generation agency. We build a predictable pipeline of
> qualified meetings for B2B teams through cold calling, LinkedIn outreach,
> and appointment setting — month-to-month, no lock-in.

## Services
- Cold calling: trained UK-based callers running outbound into target accounts,
  booking qualified meetings straight onto your sales team's calendar.
- LinkedIn inbound marketing: content and outreach that builds authority and
  pulls qualified prospects toward a conversation.
- B2B appointment setting: qualifying interest and booking vetted meetings,
  confirmed and ready to run.
- B2B lead generation: sourcing and qualifying leads that match your ideal
  customer profile, so pipeline is built on fit, not volume.
- Account-based marketing: focused multi-channel campaigns into high-value
  accounts, multi-threading every decision-maker on the buying committee.

## Who it's for
B2B decision-makers (founders, sales leaders, heads of growth) at SaaS,
recruitment, professional services, agency and e-commerce companies with a
sales team and a defined deal size.

## Pricing
Per-channel and month-to-month with no lock-in. Current rates are shown on the
site in your region's currency, or scoped on a discovery call.
